name: Schneider Electric 800 VDC sidecar (in development)
description: AC-to-800 VDC sidecar being co-developed with NVIDIA: modular power conversion shelves, modular energy storage for short-term backup and load smoothing, Live Swap. No model name, efficiency or ship date published.

capacity_w.note: vendor press release: 'capable of powering racks of up to 1.2 MW'; product in development, not a datasheet rating

efficiency.note: Schneider only says 'industry-leading efficiency'. Assumed equal to peer 800 VDC rectifier racks (Delta: AC-DC up to 98%)
